readback_body:
## Requirements: Source-generated public Protocol Reference and Git-derived Since Nession

### Problem and product boundary

Nession's public Pages should expose a read-only **Documents / Protocol Reference** generated from its canonical Rust protocol catalog. Each Protocol Unit/contract v1-v2 shows its request/response shapes and nested field details, with **one** field-level `Since Nession` entry pointing to the first provable **Nession Release** version (e.g. `0.36.0`), not the contract version or a support matrix. The feature belongs entirely to the standalone anonymous Pages site, not the authenticated product Web.

A developer **never** writes `since` annotations or maintains a second protocol-version registry. Published Git Tags and exact commit SHAs, with their canonical generated schemas, are the authority. Legacy or unavailable historical evidence yields `Unknown`, not a fabricated version. A field only in main after the last verifiable release is `Unreleased`.

### Scope, decisions, and provenance

- Current public Documents: `#/documents`, protocol search, owner navigation, contract selector, request/response nested fields, responsive details, source SHA links, expandable JSON Schema. Existing Pages visual language; no new product Web UI.
- Canonical source: `crates/nession-protocol-codegen` at the pinned main SHA, keeping Rust request/response schema and `$defs` as the only definition.
- Released `since`: list official stable GitHub Releases, resolve `vX.Y.Z` to tag commit SHA; prefer the verified Release Schema asset; otherwise a credential-free precompute can generate the schema from that **exact historic tag**. Cache under immutable SHA and diff matching protocol/contract/direction/variant/field path. No tags inferred from Cargo workspace version.
- Historical tag codegen executes only in the credential-free pre-build step; the token-bearing Pages publisher only reads pinned generated JSON. A failed/unavailable/unsupported legacy generator is `Unknown`. Current-main codegen failure blocks publication. Avoid releasing secrets, runtime session data or untrusted HTML.
- The existing deployment workflow owns the cache/precompute router in independently merged [#3190](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/3190); the feature implementation is [#3175](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/3175).
- **Prototype:** Not needed. The Protocol Reference reuses the already defined Pages navigation, list/details, tabs and responsive grammar; its real Chromium Pages fixture exercises desktop/mobile interactions instead of introducing a new paradigm. A future Docs authoring/editing experience would require its own prototype.
- **SC verification scenarios:** SC-01 and SC-02 use **SCN-01 (source/deterministic contract)**: exact SHA Node schema/version/cache/security tests plus source review. SC-03 uses **SCN-02 (Web/mobile interaction)**: independently executed, exact PR-head `CI / Pages` Chromium browser run (desktop/mobile, navigation, one-column display), its test code/assertions and authenticated job result reviewed read-only. Each is available on `when: pr`; no feature runtime, unapproved provider credentials, or deployed-stage proof is required for these pre-merge assertions. Public deployment remains a separate main-push publisher/readback outcome and must not be inferred from PR smoke.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 Given the exact pinned main revision, the Pages Documents projection includes the complete canonical Rust Protocol Unit catalog, every present contract version, and typed Request/Response fields including nested and variant fields; absent halves remain explicit, and the browser can navigate and search the generated result without a handwritten second catalog.
- [x] SC-02 For any field, `Since Nession` is a **single** Release SemVer only when adjacent Git Tag SHA-pinned generated schemas prove absent→present with no unverified later gap; missing legacy/tag/schema evidence remains `Unknown` and a verified unreleased main-only field remains `Unreleased`. A wrong SHA, forged snapshot or noncanonical schema is rejected; credentialed publishing never executes historical tag code or requires handwritten `since` annotations.
- [ ] SC-03 On desktop and mobile, the standalone Pages Documents UI exposes the exact protocol and contract selection, search and field detail, the single `Since Nession` column, stable navigation/deep-link refresh, no narrow-screen horizontal overflow, and truthful unavailable states. Evidence must include real passed Chromium assertions for this exact PR head; source or design prose alone is insufficient.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml
acceptance:
  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-02:
    when: pr
    method: agent
  SC-03:
    when: pr
    method: agent
```

## Acceptance Report

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SC-01 | Pass | run 42824296490; ref 13f7f9bc07c9ccd9a225ba25ebd056fe1a0f7585; source agent-qwen; file: crates/nession-protocol-codegen/src/catalog.rs (2455-line canonical Rust protocol catalog); file: pages/scripts/documents-project.mjs generates complete projection with protocols[], versions[], request/response fields including path/variant/type/required/since; file: pages/documents.js provides navigation, search, contract version selectors, field tables, explicit 'no response payload' for one-way protocols; test: pages/tests/documents.test.mjs validates projection schema_version 4, SHA pinning, field structure; summary: Complete canonical Rust Protocol Unit catalog projected with all contract versions, typed Request/Response fields (including nested/variant), explicit absent halves, browser navigation/search without handwritten catalog |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 42824296490; ref 13f7f9bc07c9ccd9a225ba25ebd056fe1a0f7585; source agent-qwen; file: pages/scripts/documents-project.mjs fieldSince() function (lines 109-119) implements three-state logic: verified (single SemVer when absent→present proven), unknown (missing data), unreleased (main-only); file: pages/scripts/protocol-git-history.mjs validates tag format (v\d+.\d+.\d+), 40-hex SHA, compares fetched SHA with API-pinned SHA, creates isolated worktree at exact SHA; file: pages/scripts/build.mjs lines 181-188 enforce credential-free producer (strips GITHUB_TOKEN, HOME, CARGO_HOME) before Pages publisher reads SHA-keyed cache; file: pages/AGENTS.md lines 24-27 document single Since Nession per field, absent→present requirement, missing data → Unknown rule; summary: Single Release SemVer only when git tag SHA-pinned schemas prove absent→present; Unknown for missing evidence; Unreleased for main-only fields; credential-free historical codegen with SHA validation; no handwritten annotations |
| SC-03 | Pending | run 42824296490; ref 13f7f9bc07c9ccd9a225ba25ebd056fe1a0f7585; source agent-qwen; file: e2e/tests/browser/pages-documents.spec.ts exists with desktop (1365x900), mobile (390x844), unavailable state test cases; file: Test assertions verify: Since Nession column (not matrix), version selectors, deep links, search, no horizontal overflow, truthful unavailable states; file: e2e/helpers/pagesStandalone.ts provides isolated documents fixture with all three since_status values; summary: Test files and assertions exist for desktop/mobile UI, protocol/contract selection, search, Since Nession column, navigation, no overflow, unavailable states; however ci_evidence is null so cannot verify tests actually passed at exact PR head SHA 13f7f9bc07c9ccd9a225ba25ebd056fe1a0f7585 (requirement explicitly requires real passed Chromium assertions, not just test source code) |

## Knowledge Impact

- Decision: None
- Related knowledge: `docs/architecture/protocol.md` and existing canonical Rust codegen/Pages documentation
- Reason: This is a read-only presentation and derived build history, not a new Protocol semantic contract. Stable Protocol semantics remain owned by existing Rust architecture; Pages owner docs are updated in the feature PR.
- Owner and timing: Pages implementation PR #3175, before publication
- Evidence: Source-pinned `pages/README.md`, `pages/AGENTS.md`, and generated Schema tests on the feature branch

## Product alignment

- [x] Supports VISION.md: an accessible public read-only technical reference for one coherent workspace
- [x] Respects PRINCIPLE.md: one quiet entry, progressive disclosure, precise source provenance
- [x] Uses canonical Protocol contracts and Pages design ownership; no duplicate source model
- [x] Does not claim PR CI evidence proves an actual public deployment

---
**Status:** Approved
